metadata.title: Planetary Repair & Carbon Engineering
metadata.notes: Closing the macro-cycles of the planet through technical intervention.

nodes.title: Atmospheric Carbon Scrubbing
nodes.description: Direct Air Capture (DAC) fundamentals. Designing localized scrubbing arrays that convert CO2 into structural carbon using the Mycelix Foundry. (Ref. symthaea-clime).

nodes.title: Precision Fermentation & Caloric Decoupling
nodes.description: Brewing the future. Designing automated bio-reactors for microbial protein and fat synthesis. Decoupling human caloric needs from land-use constraints.

nodes.title: Marine Remediation Swarms
nodes.description: Coordinating autonomous fleets for oceanic healing. Micro-plastic recovery algorithms and reef-stewardship drones. (Ref. symthaea-abyssal).

nodes.title: Molecular Sieve Design
nodes.description: Designing high-efficiency catalytic surfaces for pollutant sequestration. Using the EML backend to model thermodynamic efficiency of capture cycles.

nodes.title: The Planetary Repair Capstone
nodes.description: Design and simulate a closed-loop 'Planetary Lung' node. Must achieve net-negative carbon and produce 100% pod-caloric needs without external inputs.

holonic_capstone.deliverable: A verified metabolic audit showing perfect material closure and positive ecological impact.

edges.rationale: Advanced carbon materials are the building blocks of efficient scrubbing arrays.
Synthetic biology is the prerequisite for designing protein-brewing microbes.
Planetary repair requires active atmospheric carbon management.
